title: Bash command timeouts due to shell hangs
body:
**Bug Description**
Bash commands always timeout with code 143. I use MacOS with fish, tmux, & alacritty. I get the same problem in the default MacOS terminal with bash (without tmux).

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: tmux
- Version: 0.2.9
- Feedback ID: 66dc2745-228b-47a3-a286-30ea14afc296

Example:
```
> Can you merge in the dev branch? Make sure it is up to date with the remote first. Make resonable choices about what to get, and make sure not to remove functionality, but to instead combine it with the changes on the current branch.

⏺ I'll merge the dev branch into our current branch, making sure to get the latest remote changes. Let me handle this for you.

⏺ Bash(git branch -a)…
  ⎿  Command execution timed out
     Exit code 143

⏺ Bash(git branch -a)…
  ⎿  Command execution timed out
     Exit code 143

⏺ Let me try using a different approach to get branch information.

⏺ Bash(git fetch && git branch)…
  ⎿  Command execution timed out
     Exit code 143

⏺ I'm having trouble with the git commands timing out. Let me try with a more focused approach:

⏺ Bash(git fetch origin dev && git merge origin/dev)…
  ⎿  Command execution timed out
     Exit code 143

⏺ Let me try breaking this down into smaller steps with shorter timeouts:

⏺ Bash(git fetch origin)…
  ⎿  Command execution timed out
     Exit code 143

⏺ It seems there might be network or repository issues causing timeouts. Let me try a different approach:

⏺ Bash(git remote -v)…
  ⎿  Command execution timed out
     Exit code 143

⏺ I'm experiencing timeouts with git commands. This could be due to network issues or repository configuration. Let me try one more approach:

⏺ Bash(git status)…
  ⎿  Command execution timed out
     Exit code 143
```
author: ekvanox
